questions.question: TLS handshake qanday ishlaydi va sertifikat nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: TLS — shifrlash + server autentifikatsiyasi. Sertifikat = public key + domen nomi + muddat, CA imzolagan. Client zanjirni ishonchli root CA'gacha tekshiradi, keyin key exchange (ECDHE) bilan session kalit kelishiladi.

questions.question: `openssl` bilan sertifikatni tekshirish: muddat, domen, zanjir, masofaviy server.
questions.explanation: Masofaviy: `openssl s_client -connect host:443 -servername host -showcerts`. Fayl: `openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -text/-dates/-subject/-issuer/-ext subjectAltName`. Muddat tekshiruvi: `-checkend`.

questions.question: CSR yaratish, self-signed sertifikat, formatlar: PEM, DER, PFX/P12, CRT/KEY.
questions.explanation: `openssl req -new -newkey ... -keyout key.pem -out req.csr` — CA'ga beriladigan so'rov. Self-signed: `openssl req -x509`. PEM — base64 (-----BEGIN), DER — binary, PFX/P12 — kalit+sertifikat+zanjir bitta parol bilan (Windows/Java).

questions.question: Let's Encrypt / certbot: sertifikat olish va avtomatik yangilash qanday?
questions.explanation: certbot ACME protokoli orqali domenni tasdiqlaydi (HTTP-01: :80'da token fayl; DNS-01: TXT yozuv, wildcard uchun). Sertifikat 90 kun; certbot timer kuniga 2 marta tekshiradi, 30 kun qolganda yangilaydi; deploy hook bilan nginx reload.

questions.question: Nginx asosiy buyruqlari va config tuzilishi: `nginx -t`, reload, server block, location.
questions.explanation: `nginx -t` sintaksis tekshiruvi, `systemctl reload nginx` (yoki `nginx -s reload`) downtime'siz. Tuzilma: `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf` -> `http {}` -> `server {}` (sites-enabled / conf.d) -> `location {}`. `nginx -T` — to'liq yig'ilgan config.

questions.question: Nginx'ni reverse proxy + TLS sifatida sozlash (Go/Node backend oldida).
questions.explanation: `proxy_pass http://upstream;` + kerakli header'lar (Host, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto), timeout'lar, keepalive upstream, 80 -> 443 redirect, ssl_certificate fullchain, HSTS.

questions.question: Nginx 502 Bad Gateway, 504 Gateway Timeout, 413, 499 — sabablari va tekshirish.
questions.explanation: 502 — upstream'ga ulanib bo'lmadi yoki noto'g'ri javob (backend o'lgan, noto'g'ri port, socket ruxsati, SELinux). 504 — upstream vaqtida javob bermadi (proxy_read_timeout). 413 — client_max_body_size. 499 — client nginx javobini kutmay ulanishni yopdi.

questions.question: Nginx performance va himoya: worker'lar, keepalive, gzip, caching, rate limiting.
questions.explanation: `worker_processes auto`, `worker_connections`, `worker_rlimit_nofile`; keepalive client/upstream; gzip/brotli; `proxy_cache`; `limit_req_zone` + `limit_conn`; `server_tokens off`; timeout'lar (slowloris).
